<thought>Based on the notes, subnetwork 1 consists of two resistors between terminals A and X1, where one resistor’s value is twice the other. Assuming a simple series connection (the most straightforward topology for two resistors), the total measured resistance of 6.667 Ω equals R + 2R = 3R. Solving gives R ≈ 2.222 Ω and the larger resistor ≈ 4.444 Ω. The series topology can be represented with an intermediate node (e.g., N1) connecting the two resistors.</thought>
<final_answer>{"resistors": {"R1": 2.222, "R2": 4.444}, "connections": [["A", "N1", "R1"], ["N1", "X1", "R2"]]}</final_answer>
